ko.title: 35만 명의 농업 노동자, 하나의 판결: 트럼프의 H-2A 임금 삭감을 무효화한 법원 판결의 내막

segments.src: ## A Setback for the Administration's Farm Labor Wage Overhaul
segments.tr: ## 행정부의 농업 노동 임금 개편에 제동이 걸리다

segments.src: A federal court has dealt a significant blow to the Trump administration's effort to rewrite how wages are calculated for hundreds of thousands of migrant agricultural workers, ruling that the U.S.
segments.tr: 연방 법원은 수십만 명의 이주 농업 노동자의 임금 산정 방식을 재작성하려는 트럼프 행정부의 노력에 중대한 타격을 입혔으며, 미국

segments.src: Department of Labor's overhaul of the H-2A guest worker wage rules was largely arbitrary and adopted without the public input the law requires.
segments.tr: 노동부의 H-2A 게스트 워커 임금 규정 개편은 대개 자의적이었고 법이 요구하는 대중의견 수렴 없이 채택되었다고 판결했습니다.

segments.src: The decision, which farmworker advocacy groups have described as a major victory, effectively sends the Labor Department back to the drawing board on a policy that determines take-home pay for roughly 350,000 workers who come to the United States each year under the H-2A visa program to plant, tend, and harvest crops on American farms.
segments.tr: 농업 노동자 권익 옹호 단체들이 주요 승리로 평가한 이번 판결은 미국 농장에서 작물을 심고, 돌보고, 수확하기 위해 H-2A 비자 프로그램을 통해 매년 미국으로 오는 약 35만 명의 노동자의 실수령액을 결정하는 정책에 대해 노동부가 사실상 원점에서 재검토하도록 만들었습니다.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## H-2A 임금 규정의 실제 역할

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.
segments.tr: H-2A 프로그램은 미국

segments.src: farms to hire foreign workers temporarily when they say they cannot find enough domestic labor.
segments.tr: 농장이 국내 노동력을 충분히 구할 수 없을 때 임시로 외국인 노동자를 고용할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: 고용주가 수입 노동력을 사용하여 미국 노동자의 임금을 깎는 것을 방지하기 위해, 이 프로그램은 농장이 불리 영향 임금률(Adverse Effect Wage Rate, 또는 AEWR)이라고 알려진 정부가 설정한 최저 임금 기준 이상을 지불하도록 요구합니다.

segments.src: That rate is recalculated periodically using U.S.
segments.tr: 해당 임금률은 미국

segments.src: Department of Agriculture wage surveys and other labor market data.
segments.tr: 농무부 임금 조사 및 기타 노동 시장 데이터를 사용하여 주기적으로 재산정됩니다.

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: 올해 초, 행정부는 해당 산정 방식의 근간이 되는 방법론을 변경하려 했으며, 이는 농업 노동 비용이 광범위한 이민 논쟁의 쟁점이 된 시점에서 임금을 낮게 유지하기 위해 고안된 것이라고 농업 노동자 단체들과 여러 노동조합이 주장했습니다.

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: 반면 농업계 협회들은 현재의 임금 산정 공식이 오래되었으며 재배업자들에게 지역 노동 시장이 정당화하는 것보다 더 많은 비용을 지불하도록 강요하여 이미 얇은 마진을 압박하고 있다고 오랫동안 주장해 왔습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## 판사가 이를 무효화한 이유

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: 판결에 따르면, 법원은 어느 쪽의 경제적 주장이 더 나은지에 대해서는 판단을 내리지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: 대신 판사는 절차에 초점을 맞추었습니다. 연방 기관들은 일반적으로 행정절차법(Administrative Procedure Act)에 따른 요건인 제안 공고, 대중 의견 접수, 그리고 제기된 우려에 대한 답변을 먼저 거치지 않고는 이 정도 규모의 규정을 변경할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: 법원은 노동부가 그 절차를 대거 우회했으며 새로운 방법론에 대한 추론의 핵심 부분이 규제 제정 기록상의 증거에 의해 적절히 설명되거나 뒷받침되지 않았음을 발견했습니다.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: 행정법에서 예고 및 의견 수렴 절차를 건너뛰고 취약하거나 일관되지 않은 근거를 제시하는 이러한 결합은, 기저에 깔린 정책 목표의 정당성 여부와 상관없이 법원이 규정을 "자의적이고 변덕스럽다"고 판결하여 무효화하는 흔한 근거가 됩니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: 이번 판결이 행정부의 농업 노동자 임금 접근법이 완전히 끝났음을 반드시 의미하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: 이는 노동부가 절차를 재시작하고, 제안된 변경 사항을 공고하며, 재배업자, 노동자 옹호자, 경제학자 및 기타 이해관계자로부터 대중의 의견을 수렴하고, 유사한 정책을 추진하고자 할 경우 더욱 철저한 근거를 제시해야 함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: 그동안 이전의 임금 산정 규정은 계속 효력을 유지할 것으로 예상되며, 이는 H-2A 계약을 맺은 농업 노동자들이 문제의 규정 대신 이전의 공식에 따라 계속 임금을 받아야 함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: 농업 노동자 권익 옹호 단체들은 이번 판결이 시간을 벌어주고 게스트 워커 임금 책정 방식에 대한 보다 투명한 논의를 강제한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 한편, 농업 고용주 그룹은 비용이 많이 들고 경직되어 있다고 생각하는 시스템의 변경을 위해 행정부와 의회를 계속 압박할 가능성이 높으며, 이로 인해 향후 몇 달 동안 또 한 차례의 규제 제정 과정, 그리고 아마도 더 많은 소송이 이어질 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: 이번 사건은 최근 몇 년간 반복되는 주제를 부각시킵니다. 즉, 법원은 연방 정책이 좋은지 나쁜지뿐만 아니라 해당 기관이 이를 채택하기 위해 올바른 법적 절차를 따랐는지를 점점 더 면밀히 조사하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: 계절별 외국인 노동력에 크게 의존하는 산업과, 대다수의 미국인이 들어본 적도 없는 공식에 수입이 좌우되는 노동자들에게 H-2A 임금률을 둘러싼 싸움은 아직 끝나지 않았으며, 단지 대중 의견 수렴 기간이 다시 한번 격전지가 될 규제 제정 단계로 되돌아갔을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## H-2A 工资规则的实际作用

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.

segments.tr: 今年早些时候，政府开始改变该计算方法背后的逻辑——农场工人团体和几个工会认为，在农业劳动力成本已成为更广泛移民辩论焦点的时刻，这一转变旨在压低工资。而农场行业协会则长期以来一直认为，现行的工资制定公式已经过时，迫使种植者支付高于当地劳动力市场合理水平的工资，从而挤压了本已微薄的利润。

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## 法官推翻该规则的原因

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: 根据裁决，法院并未权衡哪一方拥有更好的经济论据。

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: 相反，法官将重点放在了程序上：联邦机构通常不能在未先公布提案、接受公众意见并对提出的担忧做出回应的情况下，改变如此重大的规则——这是《行政程序法》的要求。

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: 法院发现，劳工部在很大程度上绕过了这一程序，并且其采用新方法的主要理由在规则制定记录中没有得到充分的解释或证据支持。

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: 在行政法中，这种结合——跳过通知和评论程序，并提供薄弱或不一致的理由——是法院以“任意和反复无常”为由废除某项规则的常见依据，无论其背后的政策目标是否合法。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的发展

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: 该裁决并不一定意味着政府解决农场工人工资问题的方法已经失效。

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: 这意味着劳工部必须重新启动该程序，公布其拟议的变更，收集种植者、工人倡导者、经济学家和其他利益相关者的公众意见，如果它想推进类似的政策，则需要提供更详尽的理由。

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: 与此同时，先前的工资制定规则预计将继续有效，这意味着 H-2A 合同下的农场工人应继续按照先前的公式而不是受到质疑的公式获得报酬。

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: 农场工人倡导组织表示，该决定争取了时间，并迫使人们对如何制定临时工工资进行更透明的辩论。

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 与此同时，农业雇主团体可能会继续向政府和国会施压，要求改变他们认为成本高昂且缺乏弹性的系统，从而在未来几个月内引发新一轮的规则制定——以及可能更多的诉讼。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更宏观的图景

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: 此案突显了近年来一个反复出现的主题：法院越来越多地不仅审查联邦政策的好坏，还审查该机构是否遵循了正确的法律步骤来采纳该政策。

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: 对于一个严重依赖季节性外国劳动力的行业，以及对于那些收入取决于极少数美国人听说过的公式的工人来说，围绕 H-2A 工资率的斗争远未结束——它只是回到了规则制定阶段，公众意见征询期将再次成为战场。

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## H-2A वेतन नियम वास्तव में क्या करता है

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.
segments.tr: H-2A कार्यक्रम अमेरिकी

segments.src: farms to hire foreign workers temporarily when they say they cannot find enough domestic labor.
segments.tr: खेतों को अस्थायी रूप से विदेशी श्रमिकों को काम पर रखने की अनुमति देता है जब उनका कहना होता है कि उन्हें पर्याप्त घरेलू श्रम नहीं मिल रहा है।

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: नियोक्ताओं को अमेरिकी श्रमिकों के वेतन को कम करने के लिए आयातित श्रम का उपयोग करने से रोकने के लिए, कार्यक्रम खेतों को सरकार द्वारा निर्धारित वेतन सीमा का भुगतान करने के लिए मजबूर करता है जिसे प्रतिकूल प्रभाव वेतन दर (Adverse Effect Wage Rate) या AEWR के रूप में जाना जाता है।

segments.src: That rate is recalculated periodically using U.S.
segments.tr: उस दर की समय-समय पर अमेरिकी

segments.src: Department of Agriculture wage surveys and other labor market data.
segments.tr: कृषि विभाग के वेतन सर्वेक्षणों और अन्य श्रम बाजार डेटा का उपयोग करके पुनर्गणना की जाती है।

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: इस साल की शुरुआत में, प्रशासन ने उस गणना के पीछे की कार्यप्रणाली को बदलने का कदम उठाया — एक ऐसा बदलाव जिसे खेतिहर मजदूर समूहों और कई यूनियनों ने तर्क दिया कि इसे ऐसे समय में वेतन को कम रखने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था जब कृषि श्रम लागत व्यापक आव्रजन बहस में एक ज्वलंत मुद्दा बन गई है।

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: कृषि उद्योग संघों ने, अपनी ओर से, लंबे समय से तर्क दिया है कि वर्तमान वेतन-निर्धारण फॉर्मूला पुराना है और उत्पादकों को स्थानीय श्रम बाजारों द्वारा उचित ठहराए जाने से अधिक भुगतान करने के लिए मजबूर करता है, जिससे पहले से ही कम मार्जिन पर दबाव पड़ता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## न्यायाधीश ने इसे क्यों रद्द किया

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: फैसले के अनुसार, अदालत ने इस बात पर विचार नहीं किया कि किस पक्ष का आर्थिक तर्क बेहतर है।

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, न्यायाधीश ने प्रक्रिया पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया: संघीय एजेंसियां आमतौर पर पहले प्रस्ताव प्रकाशित किए बिना, सार्वजनिक टिप्पणियों को स्वीकार किए बिना, और उठाई गई चिंताओं का जवाब दिए बिना इस परिमाण के नियम को नहीं बदल सकती हैं — जो प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया अधिनियम (Administrative Procedure Act) के तहत एक आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: अदालत ने पाया कि श्रम विभाग ने काफी हद तक उस प्रक्रिया को दरकिनार कर दिया और नई कार्यप्रणाली के लिए उसके तर्क के प्रमुख हिस्सों को नियम बनाने के रिकॉर्ड में सबूतों द्वारा पर्याप्त रूप से समझाया या समर्थित नहीं किया गया था।

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: प्रशासनिक कानून में, वह संयोजन — नोटिस-और-टिप्पणी प्रक्रियाओं को छोड़ना और कमजोर या असंगत औचित्य प्रदान करना — अदालतों के लिए किसी नियम को "मनमाना और अस्थिर" (arbitrary and capricious) मानकर रद्द करने का एक सामान्य आधार है, चाहे अंतर्निहित नीति लक्ष्य वैध हो या नहीं।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: इस फैसले का मतलब यह नहीं है कि खेतिहर मजदूरों के वेतन के प्रति प्रशासन का दृष्टिकोण खत्म हो गया है।

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह है कि श्रम विभाग को प्रक्रिया को फिर से शुरू करना होगा, अपने प्रस्तावित परिवर्तनों को प्रकाशित करना होगा, उत्पादकों, श्रमिक अधिवक्ताओं, अर्थशास्त्रियों और अन्य हितधारकों से सार्वजनिक टिप्पणियां एकत्र करनी होंगी, और यदि वह समान नीति के साथ आगे बढ़ना चाहता है तो अधिक गहन औचित्य प्रदान करना होगा।

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: इस बीच, पिछले वेतन-निर्धारण नियम प्रभावी रहने की उम्मीद है, जिसका अर्थ है कि H-2A अनुबंधों के तहत खेतिहर मजदूरों को चुनौती दिए गए फॉर्मूले के बजाय पिछले फॉर्मूले के तहत भुगतान किया जाना जारी रहना चाहिए।

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: खेतिहर मजदूर वकालत संगठनों का कहना है कि यह निर्णय समय खरीदता है और अतिथि श्रमिकों का वेतन कैसे निर्धारित किया जाता है, इस पर अधिक पारदर्शी बहस के लिए मजबूर करता है।

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: इस बीच, कृषि नियोक्ता समूह प्रशासन और कांग्रेस पर उस प्रणाली में बदलाव के लिए दबाव डालना जारी रखेंगे जिसे वे महंगा और अनम्य मानते हैं, जिससे आने वाले महीनों में नियम बनाने का एक और दौर — और संभवतः अधिक मुकदमेबाजी — शुरू हो जाएगी।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: यह मामला हाल के वर्षों में एक आवर्ती विषय को उजागर करता है: अदालतें तेजी से न केवल यह जांच रही हैं कि कोई संघीय नीति अच्छी है या बुरी, बल्कि यह भी कि क्या एजेंसी ने इसे अपनाने के लिए सही कानूनी कदमों का पालन किया है।

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: एक ऐसे उद्योग के लिए जो मौसमी विदेशी श्रम पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर है, और उन श्रमिकों के लिए जिनकी कमाई एक ऐसे फॉर्मूले पर टिकी है जिसके बारे में बहुत कम अमेरिकियों ने सुना है, H-2A वेतन दर पर लड़ाई अभी खत्म नहीं हुई है — यह बस नियम बनाने के चरण में वापस चली गई है, जहां सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी अवधि एक बार फिर युद्ध का मैदान बन जाएगी।

es.title: 350.000 trabajadores agrícolas, un fallo: Análisis de la decisión judicial que anuló los recortes salariales del programa H-2A de Trump

segments.src: ## A Setback for the Administration's Farm Labor Wage Overhaul
segments.tr: ## Un revés para la reforma salarial de la mano de obra agrícola de la administración

segments.src: A federal court has dealt a significant blow to the Trump administration's effort to rewrite how wages are calculated for hundreds of thousands of migrant agricultural workers, ruling that the U.S.
segments.tr: Un tribunal federal ha asestado un duro golpe a los esfuerzos de la administración Trump por reescribir la forma en que se calculan los salarios de cientos de miles de trabajadores agrícolas migrantes, al dictaminar que la

segments.src: Department of Labor's overhaul of the H-2A guest worker wage rules was largely arbitrary and adopted without the public input the law requires.
segments.tr: reforma de las normas salariales para trabajadores invitados H-2A del Departamento de Trabajo de EE. UU. fue en gran medida arbitraria y se adoptó sin la participación pública que exige la ley.

segments.src: The decision, which farmworker advocacy groups have described as a major victory, effectively sends the Labor Department back to the drawing board on a policy that determines take-home pay for roughly 350,000 workers who come to the United States each year under the H-2A visa program to plant, tend, and harvest crops on American farms.
segments.tr: La decisión, que los grupos de defensa de los trabajadores agrícolas han calificado como una gran victoria, obliga efectivamente al Departamento de Trabajo a replantearse una política que determina el salario neto de aproximadamente 350.000 trabajadores que llegan a Estados Unidos cada año bajo el programa de visas H-2A para plantar, cuidar y cosechar cultivos en granjas estadounidenses.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Qué hace realmente la norma salarial H-2A

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.
segments.tr: El programa H-2A permite a las granjas de EE. UU.

segments.src: farms to hire foreign workers temporarily when they say they cannot find enough domestic labor.
segments.tr: contratar trabajadores extranjeros temporalmente cuando afirman que no pueden encontrar suficiente mano de obra nacional.

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: Para evitar que los empleadores utilicen mano de obra importada para reducir los salarios de los trabajadores estadounidenses, el programa exige que las granjas paguen al menos un salario mínimo establecido por el gobierno conocido como Tasa Salarial por Efecto Adverso, o AEWR (por sus siglas en inglés).

segments.src: That rate is recalculated periodically using U.S.
segments.tr: Esa tasa se recalcula periódicamente utilizando las encuestas salariales del Departamento de Agricultura de EE. UU.

segments.src: Department of Agriculture wage surveys and other labor market data.
segments.tr: y otros datos del mercado laboral.

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: A principios de este año, la administración tomó medidas para cambiar la metodología detrás de ese cálculo, un cambio que los grupos de trabajadores agrícolas y varios sindicatos argumentaron que estaba diseñado para mantener los salarios bajos en un momento en que los costos de la mano de obra agrícola se han convertido en un punto crítico en el debate más amplio sobre la inmigración.

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: Las asociaciones de la industria agrícola, por su parte, han argumentado durante mucho tiempo que la fórmula actual de fijación de salarios está obsoleta y obliga a los productores a pagar más de lo que justifican los mercados laborales locales, lo que reduce unos márgenes de beneficio ya de por sí estrechos.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## Por qué el juez la anuló

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: Según el fallo, el tribunal no se pronunció sobre qué parte tiene el mejor argumento económico.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: En cambio, el juez se centró en el proceso: las agencias federales generalmente no pueden cambiar una norma de esta magnitud sin publicar primero una propuesta, aceptar comentarios públicos y responder a las preocupaciones planteadas, un requisito bajo la Ley de Procedimiento Administrativo.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: El tribunal determinó que el Departamento de Trabajo pasó por alto en gran medida ese proceso y que partes clave de su razonamiento para la nueva metodología no fueron explicadas adecuadamente ni respaldadas por la evidencia en el registro de elaboración de normas.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: En derecho administrativo, esa combinación —omitir los procedimientos de notificación y comentarios y ofrecer una justificación débil o inconsistente— es una base común para que los tribunales anulen una norma por ser "arbitraria y caprichosa", independientemente de si el objetivo político subyacente es legítimo.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede ahora

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: El fallo no significa necesariamente que el enfoque de la administración sobre los salarios de los trabajadores agrícolas haya muerto.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Significa que el Departamento de Trabajo debe reiniciar el proceso, publicar sus cambios propuestos, recopilar comentarios públicos de productores, defensores de los trabajadores, economistas y otras partes interesadas, y proporcionar una justificación más exhaustiva si desea seguir adelante con una política similar.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, se espera que las normas anteriores de fijación de salarios permanezcan vigentes, lo que significa que los trabajadores agrícolas bajo contratos H-2A deberían seguir recibiendo sus pagos bajo la fórmula anterior en lugar de la impugnada.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones de defensa de los trabajadores agrícolas dicen que la decisión gana tiempo y fuerza un debate más transparente sobre cómo se fija el salario de los trabajadores invitados.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Los grupos de empleadores agrícolas, mientras tanto, probablemente seguirán presionando a la administración y al Congreso para obtener cambios en un sistema que consideran costoso e inflexible, preparando el terreno para otra ronda de elaboración de normas —y probablemente más litigios— en los próximos meses.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: El caso destaca un tema recurrente en los últimos años: los tribunales examinan cada vez más no solo si una política federal es buena o mala, sino si la agencia siguió los pasos legales correctos para adoptarla.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: Para una industria que depende en gran medida de la mano de obra extranjera estacional, y para los trabajadores cuyos ingresos dependen de una fórmula de la que pocos estadounidenses han oído hablar, la lucha por la tasa salarial H-2A está lejos de terminar; simplemente ha vuelto a la etapa de elaboración de normas, donde los períodos de comentarios públicos se convertirán una vez más en el campo de batalla.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: وجدت المحكمة أن وزارة العمل تجاوزت هذا الإجراء إلى حد كبير وأن الأجزاء الرئيسية من منطقها للمنهجية الجديدة لم يتم شرحها بشكل كافٍ أو دعمها بالأدلة في سجل وضع القواعد.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: في القانون الإداري، هذا المزيج - تخطي إجراءات الإخطار والتعليق وتقديم تبريرات ضعيفة أو غير متسقة - هو أساس شائع للمحاكم لإلغاء قاعدة باعتبارها "تعسفية ومتقلبة"، بغض النظر عما إذا كان هدف السياسة الأساسي مشروعًا.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: إنه يعني أن وزارة العمل يجب أن تعيد تشغيل العملية، وتنشر التغييرات المقترحة، وتجمع التعليقات العامة من المزارعين، ومدافعي العمال، والاقتصاديين، وغيرهم من أصحاب المصلحة، وتقدم تبريرًا أكثر شمولاً إذا أرادت المضي قدمًا في سياسة مماثلة.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، من المتوقع أن تظل قواعد تحديد الأجور السابقة سارية، مما يعني أن العمال الزراعيين بموجب عقود H-2A يجب أن يستمروا في تلقي أجورهم وفقًا للصيغة السابقة بدلاً من الصيغة التي تم الطعن فيها.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: تقول منظمات الدفاع عن العمال الزراعيين إن القرار يمنحهم الوقت ويفرض نقاشًا أكثر شفافية حول كيفية تحديد أجور العمال الضيوف.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، من المرجح أن تواصل مجموعات أصحاب العمل الزراعيين الضغط على الإدارة والكونغرس لإجراء تغييرات على نظام يرونه مكلفًا وغير مرن، مما يمهد الطريق لجولة أخرى من وضع القواعد - ومن المحتمل المزيد من التقاضي - في الأشهر المقبلة.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## الصورة الأكبر

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: تسلط القضية الضوء على موضوع متكرر في السنوات الأخيرة: المحاكم تدقق بشكل متزايد ليس فقط فيما إذا كانت السياسة الفيدرالية جيدة أو سيئة، ولكن فيما إذا كانت الوكالة قد اتبعت الخطوات القانونية الصحيحة لتبنيها.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لصناعة تعتمد بشكل كبير على العمالة الأجنبية الموسمية، وللعمال الذين تعتمد أرباحهم على صيغة لم يسمع بها سوى القليل من الأمريكيين، فإن المعركة حول معدل أجور H-2A بعيدة كل البعد عن الانتهاء - لقد انتقلت ببساطة مرة أخرى إلى مرحلة وضع القواعد، حيث ستصبح فترات التعليق العام مرة أخرى ساحة المعركة.

fr.title: 350 000 travailleurs agricoles, une seule décision : les coulisses de l'arrêt de justice qui a annulé les baisses de salaires H-2A de Trump

segments.src: ## A Setback for the Administration's Farm Labor Wage Overhaul
segments.tr: ## Un revers pour la refonte des salaires de la main-d'œuvre agricole par l'administration

segments.src: A federal court has dealt a significant blow to the Trump administration's effort to rewrite how wages are calculated for hundreds of thousands of migrant agricultural workers, ruling that the U.S.
segments.tr: Un tribunal fédéral a porté un coup dur aux efforts de l'administration Trump pour réécrire la manière dont sont calculés les salaires de centaines de milliers de travailleurs agricoles migrants, en statuant que la refonte par le

segments.src: Department of Labor's overhaul of the H-2A guest worker wage rules was largely arbitrary and adopted without the public input the law requires.
segments.tr: ministère américain du Travail des règles salariales des travailleurs invités H-2A était largement arbitraire et adoptée sans la participation du public requise par la loi.

segments.src: The decision, which farmworker advocacy groups have described as a major victory, effectively sends the Labor Department back to the drawing board on a policy that determines take-home pay for roughly 350,000 workers who come to the United States each year under the H-2A visa program to plant, tend, and harvest crops on American farms.
segments.tr: La décision, que les groupes de défense des travailleurs agricoles ont qualifiée de victoire majeure, renvoie de fait le ministère du Travail à la case départ concernant une politique qui détermine le salaire net d'environ 350 000 travailleurs qui viennent chaque année aux États-Unis dans le cadre du programme de visa H-2A pour planter, entretenir et récolter les cultures dans les fermes américaines.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Ce que fait réellement la règle salariale H-2A

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.
segments.tr: Le programme H-2A permet aux exploitations agricoles américaines

segments.src: farms to hire foreign workers temporarily when they say they cannot find enough domestic labor.
segments.tr: d'embaucher temporairement des travailleurs étrangers lorsqu'elles affirment ne pas trouver suffisamment de main-d'œuvre locale.

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: Pour éviter que les employeurs n'utilisent de la main-d'œuvre importée pour casser les salaires des travailleurs américains, le programme exige que les fermes paient au moins un salaire minimum fixé par le gouvernement, connu sous le nom de taux de salaire à effet indésirable (AEWR).

segments.src: That rate is recalculated periodically using U.S.
segments.tr: Ce taux est recalculé périodiquement à l'aide des enquêtes sur les salaires du ministère américain

segments.src: Department of Agriculture wage surveys and other labor market data.
segments.tr: de l'Agriculture et d'autres données sur le marché du travail.

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: Plus tôt cette année, l'administration a pris des mesures pour modifier la méthodologie de ce calcul — un changement qui, selon les groupes de travailleurs agricoles et plusieurs syndicats, visait à maintenir les salaires à un niveau bas à un moment où les coûts de la main-d'œuvre agricole sont devenus un point de friction dans le débat plus large sur l'immigration.

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: Les associations de l'industrie agricole, de leur côté, soutiennent depuis longtemps que la formule actuelle de fixation des salaires est obsolète et oblige les producteurs à payer plus que ce que justifient les marchés du travail locaux, ce qui comprime des marges déjà minces.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le juge l'a annulée

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: Selon la décision, le tribunal ne s'est pas prononcé sur la question de savoir quel camp avait le meilleur argument économique.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, le juge s'est concentré sur la procédure : les agences fédérales ne peuvent généralement pas modifier une règle de cette importance sans d'abord publier une proposition, accepter les commentaires du public et répondre aux préoccupations soulevées — une exigence de la loi sur la procédure administrative (Administrative Procedure Act).

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: Le tribunal a constaté que le ministère du Travail avait largement contourné ce processus et que des éléments clés de son raisonnement pour la nouvelle méthodologie n'étaient pas suffisamment expliqués ou étayés par les preuves figurant dans le dossier d'élaboration de la règle.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: En droit administratif, cette combinaison — sauter les procédures d'avis et de commentaires et proposer des justifications faibles ou incohérentes — est un motif courant pour lequel les tribunaux annulent une règle comme étant « arbitraire et capricieuse », que l'objectif politique sous-jacent soit légitime ou non.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: La décision ne signifie pas nécessairement que l'approche de l'administration concernant les salaires des travailleurs agricoles est morte.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que le ministère du Travail doit relancer le processus, publier ses propositions de modifications, recueillir les commentaires du public de la part des producteurs, des défenseurs des travailleurs, des économistes et d'autres parties prenantes, et fournir une justification plus approfondie s'il souhaite aller de l'avant avec une politique similaire.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: En attendant, les règles antérieures de fixation des salaires devraient rester en vigueur, ce qui signifie que les travailleurs agricoles sous contrat H-2A devraient continuer à être payés selon la formule précédente plutôt que selon celle contestée.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Les organisations de défense des travailleurs agricoles affirment que la décision permet de gagner du temps et impose un débat plus transparent sur la manière dont est fixé le salaire des travailleurs invités.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Les groupes d'employeurs agricoles, quant à eux, continueront probablement à faire pression sur l'administration et le Congrès pour modifier un système qu'ils jugent coûteux et rigide, ouvrant la voie à une nouvelle série d'élaboration de règles — et probablement à d'autres litiges — dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Une vue d'ensemble

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: L'affaire met en lumière un thème récurrent ces dernières années : les tribunaux examinent de plus en plus non seulement si une politique fédérale est bonne ou mauvaise, mais si l'agence a suivi les étapes juridiques correctes pour l'adopter.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: Pour une industrie qui dépend fortement de la main-d'œuvre étrangère saisonnière, et pour des travailleurs dont les revenus dépendent d'une formule dont peu d'Américains ont entendu parler, la lutte autour du taux de salaire H-2A est loin d'être terminée — elle est simplement revenue à l'étape de l'élaboration des règles, où les périodes de consultation publique deviendront une fois de plus le champ de bataille.

pt.title: 350.000 Trabalhadores Rurais, Uma Decisão: Por Dentro da Sentença Judicial Que Derrubou os Cortes Salariais do H-2A de Trump

segments.src: ## A Setback for the Administration's Farm Labor Wage Overhaul
segments.tr: ## Um Revés para a Reformulação dos Salários do Trabalho Agrícola do Governo

segments.src: A federal court has dealt a significant blow to the Trump administration's effort to rewrite how wages are calculated for hundreds of thousands of migrant agricultural workers, ruling that the U.S.
segments.tr: Um tribunal federal infligiu um golpe significativo ao esforço do governo Trump de reescrever como os salários são calculados para centenas de milhares de trabalhadores agrícolas migrantes, decidindo que o

segments.tr: A decisão, que grupos de defesa dos trabalhadores rurais descreveram como uma grande vitória, efetivamente envia o Departamento do Trabalho de volta à estaca zero em relação a uma política que determina o salário líquido de cerca de 350.000 trabalhadores que vêm para os Estados Unidos todos os anos sob o programa de visto H-2A para plantar, cuidar e colher safras em fazendas americanas.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## O Que a Regra Salarial do H-2A Realmente Faz

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: Para evitar que os empregadores usem mão de obra importada para reduzir os salários dos trabalhadores americanos, o programa exige que as fazendas paguem pelo menos um piso salarial estabelecido pelo governo, conhecido como Taxa Salarial de Efeito Adverso, ou AEWR.

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: No início deste ano, o governo se movimentou para alterar a metodologia por trás desse cálculo — uma mudança que grupos de trabalhadores rurais e vários sindicatos argumentaram ter sido projetada para conter os salários em um momento em que os custos do trabalho agrícola se tornaram um ponto de conflito no debate migratório mais amplo.

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: As associações da indústria agrícola, por sua vez, argumentam há muito tempo que a fórmula atual de fixação de salários está desatualizada e força os produtores a pagarem mais do que os mercados de trabalho locais justificam, espremendo margens que já são estreitas.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Juiz a Derrubou

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: De acordo com a decisão, o tribunal não opinou sobre qual lado tem o melhor argumento econômico.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Em vez disso, o juiz se concentrou no processo: as agências federais geralmente não podem alterar uma regra dessa magnitude sem primeiro publicar uma proposta, aceitar comentários públicos e responder às preocupações levantadas — uma exigência da Lei de Procedimento Administrativo.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: O tribunal considerou que o Departamento do Trabalho ignorou amplamente esse processo e que partes fundamentais de sua fundamentação para a nova metodologia não foram adequadamente explicadas ou apoiadas pelas evidências no registro do processo regulatório.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: No direito administrativo, essa combinação — pular os procedimentos de aviso e comentário e oferecer justificativas fracas ou inconsistentes — é uma base comum para os tribunais anularem uma regra como "arbitrária e caprichosa", independentemente de o objetivo da política subjacente ser legítimo ou não.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece A Seguir

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: A decisão não significa necessariamente que a abordagem do governo em relação aos salários dos trabalhadores rurais esteja morta.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Isso significa que o Departamento do Trabalho deve reiniciar o processo, publicar suas alterações propostas, coletar comentários públicos de produtores, defensores dos trabalhadores, economistas e outras partes interessadas, e fornecer uma justificativa mais detalhada se quiser avançar com uma política semelhante.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, espera-se que as regras anteriores de fixação de salários permaneçam em vigor, o que significa que os trabalhadores rurais sob contratos H-2A devem continuar a ser pagos de acordo com a fórmula anterior, e não com a contestada.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Organizações de defesa dos trabalhadores rurais dizem que a decisão ganha tempo e força um debate mais transparente sobre como o pagamento dos trabalhadores convidados é definido.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, é provável que os grupos de empregadores agrícolas continuem pressionando o governo e o Congresso por mudanças em um sistema que consideram dispendioso e inflexível, preparando o terreno para mais uma rodada de elaboração de regras — e provavelmente mais litígios — nos próximos meses.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Quadro Geral

segments.tr: Keputusan tersebut, yang digambarkan oleh kelompok advokasi pekerja tani sebagai kemenangan besar, secara efektif mengirim Departemen Tenaga Kerja kembali ke tahap awal dalam kebijakan yang menentukan upah bersih bagi sekitar 350.000 pekerja yang datang ke Amerika Serikat setiap tahun di bawah program visa H-2A untuk menanam, merawat, dan memanen tanaman di pertanian Amerika.

segments.tr: Untuk mencegah pemberi kerja menggunakan tenaga kerja impor untuk memotong upah pekerja Amerika, program ini mengharuskan pertanian untuk membayar setidaknya batas minimum upah yang ditetapkan pemerintah yang dikenal sebagai Adverse Effect Wage Rate, atau AEWR.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Hakim Membatalkannya

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: Menurut keputusan tersebut, pengadilan tidak mempertimbangkan pihak mana yang memiliki argumen ekonomi yang lebih baik.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, hakim berfokus pada proses: lembaga federal umumnya tidak dapat mengubah aturan sebesar ini tanpa terlebih dahulu mempublikasikan proposal, menerima komentar publik, dan menanggapi kekhawatiran yang diajukan — sebuah persyaratan di bawah Administrative Procedure Act.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: Pengadilan menemukan bahwa Departemen Tenaga Kerja sebagian besar mengabaikan proses tersebut dan bahwa bagian-bagian penting dari alasannya untuk metodologi baru tidak dijelaskan secara memadai atau didukung oleh bukti dalam catatan pembuatan aturan.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: Dalam hukum administrasi, kombinasi tersebut — melewatkan prosedur pemberitahuan-dan-komentar serta menawarkan pembenaran yang lemah atau tidak konsisten — adalah dasar umum bagi pengadilan untuk membatalkan suatu aturan sebagai tindakan yang "sewenang-wenang dan tidak menentu," terlepas dari apakah tujuan kebijakan yang mendasarinya sah.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: Keputusan tersebut tidak serta merta berarti pendekatan pemerintah terhadap upah pekerja tani telah mati.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Ini berarti Departemen Tenaga Kerja harus memulai kembali prosesnya, mempublikasikan usulan perubahannya, mengumpulkan komentar publik dari para petani, advokat pekerja, ekonom, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya, serta memberikan pembenaran yang lebih menyeluruh jika ingin melanjutkan kebijakan serupa.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, aturan penetapan upah sebelumnya diperkirakan akan tetap berlaku, yang berarti pekerja tani di bawah kontrak H-2A harus terus dibayar berdasarkan formula sebelumnya, bukan formula yang digugat.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Organisasi advokasi pekerja tani mengatakan keputusan ini mengulur waktu dan memaksa debat yang lebih transparan tentang bagaimana upah pekerja tamu ditetapkan.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, kelompok pengusaha pertanian kemungkinan akan terus mendesak pemerintah dan Kongres untuk melakukan perubahan pada sistem yang mereka anggap mahal dan tidak fleksibel, yang akan memicu putaran pembuatan aturan lainnya — dan kemungkinan lebih banyak litigasi — dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.

segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Besar

segments.tr: Kasus ini menyoroti tema yang berulang dalam beberapa tahun terakhir: pengadilan semakin meneliti tidak hanya apakah kebijakan federal itu baik atau buruk, tetapi juga apakah lembaga tersebut mengikuti langkah-langkah hukum yang benar untuk mengadopsinya.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: Bagi industri yang sangat bergantung pada tenaga kerja asing musiman, dan bagi pekerja yang penghasilannya bergantung pada formula yang jarang didengar oleh sebagian besar orang Amerika, perjuangan atas tarif upah H-2A masih jauh dari selesai — perjuangan ini hanya kembali ke tahap pembuatan aturan, di mana periode komentar publik sekali lagi akan menjadi medan pertempuran.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: Das Gericht stellte fest, dass das Arbeitsministerium diesen Prozess weitgehend umgangen hat und dass wesentliche Teile seiner Begründung für die neue Methodik nicht ausreichend erklärt oder durch Beweise in den Verfahrensunterlagen gestützt wurden.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: Im Verwaltungsrecht ist diese Kombination – das Überspringen von Verfahren zur Bekanntgabe und Kommentierung sowie das Vorbringen schwacher oder inkonsistenter Begründungen – ein häufiger Grund für Gerichte, eine Regel als „willkürlich und unberechenbar“ aufzuheben, unabhängig davon, ob das zugrundeliegende politische Ziel legitim ist.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes geschieht

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: Das Urteil bedeutet nicht zwangsläufig, dass der Ansatz der Regierung für die Löhne von Landarbeitern tot ist.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Es bedeutet, dass das Arbeitsministerium den Prozess neu starten, seine vorgeschlagenen Änderungen veröffentlichen, öffentliche Kommentare von Erzeugern, Arbeitnehmervertretern, Ökonomen und anderen Interessengruppen einholen und eine gründlichere Begründung liefern muss, wenn es mit einer ähnlichen Politik fortfahren möchte.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: In der Zwischenzeit bleiben voraussichtlich die bisherigen Lohnregeln in Kraft, was bedeutet, dass Landarbeiter mit H-2A-Verträgen weiterhin nach der bisherigen Formel und nicht nach der angefochtenen bezahlt werden sollten.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Organisationen zur Unterstützung von Landarbeitern sagen, dass die Entscheidung Zeit verschafft und eine transparentere Debatte darüber erzwingt, wie die Bezahlung von Gastarbeitern festgelegt wird.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Landwirtschaftliche Arbeitgeberverbände hingegen werden wahrscheinlich weiterhin Druck auf die Regierung und den Kongress ausüben, um Änderungen an einem System zu erreichen, das sie als kostspielig und unflexibel ansehen, was in den kommenden Monaten eine weitere Runde der Regelfestsetzung – und wahrscheinlich weitere Rechtsstreitigkeiten – nach sich ziehen wird.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Das größere Ganze

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: Der Fall verdeutlicht ein wiederkehrendes Thema der letzten Jahre: Gerichte prüfen zunehmend nicht nur, ob eine Bundespolitik gut oder schlecht ist, sondern auch, ob die Behörde die korrekten rechtlichen Schritte eingehalten hat, um sie zu verabschieden.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: Für eine Branche, die stark von saisonalen ausländischen Arbeitskräften abhängig ist, und für Arbeiter, deren Verdienst von einer Formel abhängt, von der nur wenige Amerikaner jemals gehört haben, ist der Kampf um den H-2A-Lohnsatz noch lange nicht vorbei – er hat sich lediglich in die Phase der Regelfestsetzung zurückverlagert, in der die Fristen für öffentliche Kommentare wieder einmal zum Schlachtfeld werden.

vi.title: 350.000 công nhân nông nghiệp, một phán quyết: Bên trong quyết định của tòa án bác bỏ việc cắt giảm lương H-2A của Trump

segments.src: ## A Setback for the Administration's Farm Labor Wage Overhaul
segments.tr: ## Một trở ngại đối với cuộc cải tổ tiền lương lao động nông nghiệp của chính quyền

segments.src: A federal court has dealt a significant blow to the Trump administration's effort to rewrite how wages are calculated for hundreds of thousands of migrant agricultural workers, ruling that the U.S.
segments.tr: Một tòa án liên bang đã giáng một đòn mạnh vào nỗ lực của chính quyền Trump nhằm viết lại cách tính lương cho hàng trăm ngàn lao động nông nghiệp di cư, phán quyết rằng

segments.src: Department of Labor's overhaul of the H-2A guest worker wage rules was largely arbitrary and adopted without the public input the law requires.
segments.tr: Bộ Lao động Hoa Kỳ đã cải tổ các quy định về tiền lương cho lao động khách H-2A một cách tùy tiện và được thông qua mà không có sự đóng góp ý kiến từ công chúng theo yêu cầu của pháp luật.

segments.src: The decision, which farmworker advocacy groups have described as a major victory, effectively sends the Labor Department back to the drawing board on a policy that determines take-home pay for roughly 350,000 workers who come to the United States each year under the H-2A visa program to plant, tend, and harvest crops on American farms.
segments.tr: Quyết định này, được các nhóm vận động cho công nhân nông nghiệp mô tả là một chiến thắng lớn, thực sự buộc Bộ Lao động phải bắt đầu lại từ đầu đối với một chính sách xác định thu nhập thực tế cho khoảng 350.000 công nhân đến Hoa Kỳ mỗi năm theo chương trình thị thực H-2A để trồng trọt, chăm sóc và thu hoạch mùa màng tại các trang trại của Mỹ.

segments.src: ## What the H-2A Wage Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Quy định về tiền lương H-2A thực sự làm gì

segments.src: The H-2A program allows U.S.
segments.tr: Chương trình H-2A cho phép các trang trại của Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: farms to hire foreign workers temporarily when they say they cannot find enough domestic labor.
segments.tr: thuê lao động nước ngoài tạm thời khi họ cho biết không thể tìm đủ lao động trong nước.

segments.src: To prevent employers from using imported labor to undercut pay for American workers, the program requires farms to pay at least a government-set wage floor known as the Adverse Effect Wage Rate, or AEWR.
segments.tr: Để ngăn chặn người sử dụng lao động dùng lao động nhập khẩu làm giảm mức lương của công nhân Mỹ, chương trình yêu cầu các trang trại phải trả ít nhất một mức lương sàn do chính phủ quy định được gọi là Tỷ lệ lương do tác động bất lợi, hay AEWR.

segments.src: That rate is recalculated periodically using U.S.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ đó được tính toán lại định kỳ bằng cách sử dụng các khảo sát tiền lương của Bộ Nông nghiệp Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: Department of Agriculture wage surveys and other labor market data.
segments.tr: và các dữ liệu thị trường lao động khác.

segments.src: Earlier this year, the administration moved to change the methodology behind that calculation — a shift that farmworker groups and several unions argued was designed to hold wages down at a time when agricultural labor costs have become a flashpoint in the broader immigration debate.
segments.tr: Đầu năm nay, chính quyền đã chuyển sang thay đổi phương pháp đằng sau phép tính đó — một sự thay đổi mà các nhóm công nhân nông nghiệp và một số công đoàn lập luận rằng được thiết kế để giữ mức lương thấp trong thời điểm chi phí lao động nông nghiệp đã trở thành một điểm nóng trong cuộc tranh luận rộng lớn hơn về nhập cư.

segments.src: Farm industry associations, for their part, have long argued that the current wage-setting formula is outdated and forces growers to pay more than local labor markets justify, squeezing already thin margins.
segments.tr: Về phần mình, các hiệp hội ngành nông nghiệp từ lâu đã lập luận rằng công thức thiết lập tiền lương hiện tại đã lỗi thời và buộc người trồng trọt phải trả nhiều hơn mức thị trường lao động địa phương cho phép, làm thắt chặt biên lợi nhuận vốn đã mỏng manh.

segments.src: ## Why the Judge Struck It Down
segments.tr: ## Tại sao thẩm phán bác bỏ nó

segments.src: According to the ruling, the court did not weigh in on which side has the better economic argument.
segments.tr: Theo phán quyết, tòa án không cân nhắc xem bên nào có lập luận kinh tế tốt hơn.

segments.src: Instead, the judge focused on process: federal agencies generally cannot change a rule of this magnitude without first publishing a proposal, accepting public comments, and responding to the concerns raised — a requirement under the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Thay vào đó, thẩm phán tập trung vào quy trình: các cơ quan liên bang thường không thể thay đổi một quy tắc có quy mô như thế này mà không công bố đề xuất trước, chấp nhận các ý kiến đóng góp từ công chúng và phản hồi các mối quan ngại được nêu ra — một yêu cầu theo Đạo luật Thủ tục Hành chính.

segments.src: The court found that the Labor Department largely bypassed that process and that key parts of its reasoning for the new methodology were not adequately explained or supported by the evidence in the rulemaking record.
segments.tr: Tòa án nhận thấy rằng Bộ Lao động phần lớn đã bỏ qua quy trình đó và các phần chính trong lý do của họ cho phương pháp mới không được giải thích đầy đủ hoặc không được hỗ trợ bởi bằng chứng trong hồ sơ soạn thảo quy định.

segments.src: In administrative law, that combination — skipping notice-and-comment procedures and offering weak or inconsistent justification — is a common basis for courts to vacate a rule as "arbitrary and capricious," regardless of whether the underlying policy goal is legitimate.
segments.tr: Trong luật hành chính, sự kết hợp đó — bỏ qua các thủ tục thông báo và lấy ý kiến, đồng thời đưa ra sự biện minh yếu kém hoặc không nhất quán — là cơ sở phổ biến để các tòa án hủy bỏ một quy tắc vì "tùy tiện và thất thường", bất kể mục tiêu chính sách cơ bản có hợp pháp hay không.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: The ruling does not necessarily mean the administration's approach to farmworker wages is dead.
segments.tr: Phán quyết không nhất thiết có nghĩa là cách tiếp cận của chính quyền đối với tiền lương của công nhân nông nghiệp đã chấm dứt.

segments.src: It means the Labor Department must restart the process, publish its proposed changes, gather public comments from growers, worker advocates, economists, and other stakeholders, and provide a more thorough justification if it wants to move forward with a similar policy.
segments.tr: Điều đó có nghĩa là Bộ Lao động phải khởi động lại quy trình, công bố các thay đổi được đề xuất, thu thập ý kiến đóng góp từ công chúng từ những người trồng trọt, những người ủng hộ công nhân, các nhà kinh tế và các bên liên quan khác, đồng thời đưa ra sự biện minh kỹ lưỡng hơn nếu muốn tiếp tục với một chính sách tương tự.

segments.src: In the meantime, the prior wage-setting rules are expected to remain in effect, meaning farmworkers under H-2A contracts should continue to be paid under the previous formula rather than the challenged one.
segments.tr: Trong thời gian chờ đợi, các quy định thiết lập tiền lương trước đó dự kiến sẽ vẫn có hiệu lực, nghĩa là công nhân nông nghiệp theo hợp đồng H-2A sẽ tiếp tục được trả lương theo công thức cũ thay vì công thức bị thách thức.

segments.src: Farmworker advocacy organizations say the decision buys time and forces a more transparent debate over how guest worker pay is set.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức vận động cho công nhân nông nghiệp cho biết quyết định này giúp mua thêm thời gian và buộc phải có một cuộc tranh luận minh bạch hơn về cách thiết lập tiền lương cho lao động khách.

segments.src: Agricultural employer groups, meanwhile, are likely to continue pressing the administration and Congress for changes to a system they view as costly and inflexible, setting up another round of rulemaking — and likely more litigation — in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các nhóm chủ sử dụng lao động nông nghiệp có khả năng sẽ tiếp tục gây áp lực lên chính quyền và Quốc hội để thay đổi một hệ thống mà họ coi là tốn kém và thiếu linh hoạt, tạo tiền đề cho một vòng soạn thảo quy định khác — và có khả năng là nhiều vụ kiện tụng hơn — trong những tháng tới.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Bức tranh toàn cảnh

segments.src: The case highlights a recurring theme in recent years: courts increasingly scrutinizing not just whether a federal policy is good or bad, but whether the agency followed the correct legal steps to adopt it.
segments.tr: Vụ việc làm nổi bật một chủ đề tái diễn trong những năm gần đây: các tòa án ngày càng giám sát chặt chẽ không chỉ việc một chính sách liên bang là tốt hay xấu, mà còn liệu cơ quan đó có tuân thủ các bước pháp lý chính xác để thông qua nó hay không.

segments.src: For an industry that depends heavily on seasonal foreign labor, and for workers whose earnings hinge on a formula few Americans have ever heard of, the fight over the H-2A wage rate is far from over — it has simply moved back to the rulemaking stage, where public comment periods will once again become the battleground.
segments.tr: Đối với một ngành phụ thuộc nhiều vào lao động nước ngoài theo mùa, và đối với những công nhân có thu nhập phụ thuộc vào một công thức mà ít người Mỹ nào từng nghe đến, cuộc chiến về tỷ lệ lương H-2A còn lâu mới kết thúc — nó chỉ đơn giản là đã quay trở lại giai đoạn soạn thảo quy định, nơi các giai đoạn lấy ý kiến công chúng sẽ một lần nữa trở thành chiến trường.
